summary: Companion post to the critique piece above, aimed at whoever is building a benchmark rather than reading one: one section per guardrail (answer-blind queries, one-variable-per-arm including sub-agent ground-truth corruption, environment/rules-file drift between arms, establishing a nondeterminism floor before trusting a delta), each grounded in a real past incident rather than invented for the post. The answer-blind-query anecdote's source repo is deliberately left unnamed for privacy. Its own `readingTime` was first set to 9 min (about 163 words/minute for its length), inconsistent with the ~200-230 wpm the rest of the site's posts use, and corrected to 8 min before publishing.
